title: Pay discrepancies between consultants after the merger
description: Consultants in the same role are paid differently depending on the legacy company after the 2020 merger.
resolution: Built a competence matrix defining functions and required criteria, then a salary scale on top of it. Moved all compensation data into one integrated system with automated calculations and real-time insights, replacing manual Excel forecasting.

title: Adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report
description: HR needs an adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report per function level for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
resolution: Delivered from the integrated compensation system: the competence matrix and salary scale act as the job architecture, and the adjusted and unadjusted pay gap is calculated automatically per function level. No manual Excel step, so figures stay consistent between reports.

title: Which employees are in scope of the pay gap calculation?
description: Which employees must be included in the pay gap calculation?
resolution: All workers with an employment contract on the reference date, including part-time staff with pay converted to hourly pay. Interns without an employment contract are out of scope.

title: Data sources do not work as one system
description: Payroll, job matrix, Hay evaluation and benchmarking data do not work as one system yet.

title: Pay gap reporting per category of workers?
description: Do we need to report the pay gap per category of workers doing the same work or work of equal value, or is the overall gender pay gap enough for a company of our size?

title: Pay transparency training for managers
description: Managers are not aware of the directive and need training before the first report.
resolution: Three e-learning modules, an intranet FAQ page and live sessions per site.

title: Payroll in Excel files crashes and is exposed to fraud
description: Payroll runs through huge Excel files managed from the Netherlands; files crash and the process is exposed to fraud and errors.
resolution: Consolidated into one integrated HR and payroll system on SAP SuccessFactors with local support; biometric time tracking and bonus management integrated. Payroll delays ended.

title: Employee self-service for workers without smartphones
description: Self-service is not live because many workers lack smartphones; a kiosk or shared-device option is needed.

title: 47 local payroll vendors, no standard process
description: No standardised payroll process across 45 countries, poor documentation and a high error rate.
resolution: One multinational payroll provider coordinating managed payroll in all countries, regional shared service centres, partner solutions for time capture, and online payslips as the first step to self-service.

title: Overtime premium missing on German payslips
description: Overtime premium missing on the August payslips for employees at the Hamburg plant.

title: One HR system for a fast-growing plant
description: Replace the previous provider with one HR and payroll system that scales with plant growth.
resolution: Implemented SD Worx InnovaHR on SAP SuccessFactors covering org structure, HR, payroll, time management and performance, with data migration from the previous provider and automated Polish declarations.

title: Manual payslip and tax-form distribution
description: Payslips and tax forms were distributed manually, costing HR days every month.
resolution: Bulk distribution of payslips and tax documents plus manager and employee self-service; manual effort practically eliminated.

title: CLA increase not applied: retroactive corrections
description: The January collective agreement increase was not applied to shift workers; retroactive salary corrections needed.
resolution: Automated retro calculation in the payroll engine; back pay paid automatically in the next run with separate retro lines on the payslip.

title: Retroactive indexation for consultants who changed level
description: How to handle retroactive salary corrections after indexation when a consultant changed function level; back pay is corrected by hand today.

title: Leave balances wrong after migration
description: Annual leave balances of farm workers do not match the old Excel balances after the migration.
resolution: Opening balances reconciled per worker against the last approved balances, one-off correction import with audit trail, sign-off per farm.

title: Carry-over leave missing after migration
description: Carry-over leave balances are missing after the data migration from the previous provider.
resolution: Re-imported carry-over balances with an audit trail and a reconciliation report per migration wave.

title: Overtime premium missing on night shift payslips
description: The overtime premium is missing on payslips for hours above the shift schedule.
resolution: Separate wage type for overtime hours, automated validation of scheduled versus worked hours before each run, correction run for the missing premiums.

title: Dispute about late variable pay inputs and the cut-off
description: Plant managers dispute that late variable pay inputs after the mid-month cut-off are paid a month later.
resolution: Published cut-off calendar, automated reminders before the deadline, correction line for late inputs.

title: Digital time registration for the shopfloor
description: Options for badge terminals or digital clocking on the shopfloor instead of paper time sheets.
resolution: Declined by the client in June 2025: the shopfloor keeps paper time registration; no digital clocking proposal before the 2027 budget round.

title: Overtime and Sunday premium missing on payslips
description: Overtime premium and Sunday supplement missing on payslips of warehouse night shifts.
resolution: Premium codes from the planning tool mapped to dedicated wage types, automated check on worked hours without a premium, correction run, compliance review against the sector agreement.

title: Self-service for drivers without smartphones
description: Drivers without a smartphone cannot see payslips online and need an alternative to paper.
resolution: Kiosk in every depot canteen with badge and PIN login, printed payslips on request, helpdesk hour on payday.

title: Late planner inputs paid a month late
description: Mid-month cut-off dispute: trip allowances and overtime reported after the deadline are paid a month late.
resolution: Automated reminder to planners before the deadline, locked input screen after the cut-off, one correction window per month.

title: Indexation back pay for drivers
description: The indexation was applied late; retroactive salary corrections and back pay needed.
resolution: Automated retro calculation in the payroll engine, paid in the next run with separate retro lines.

title: Works council approval for time registration data
description: The works council wants guarantees before time registration data from the planning tool is used for payroll.
resolution: Consultation pack, privacy impact assessment and a test period in one depot; works council approved.

title: Three payroll vendors after acquisitions
description: Three payroll vendors with different pay calendars and wage types; no single payroll process.
resolution: One harmonised payroll design and data model, parallel runs, reconciliation per entity and a phased switch-off of the legacy vendors.

title: Store managers dispute the mid-month cut-off
description: Shift changes and overtime entered after the mid-month cut-off are paid a month late.
resolution: Fixed cut-off, a second correction window for shift changes and automated reminders to store managers.

title: Self-service for store colleagues without smartphones
description: Store colleagues without a smartphone cannot open payslips or request leave online.
resolution: Shared tablet in every store back office with badge login, and a store champion per store.

title: Adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report
description: HR needs an adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report per category of workers for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
resolution: Pay gap report from one integrated system with job families and pay grades as job architecture; gap calculated automatically per category of workers, plus a manager communication pack.

title: Leave balances differ after dry-run migration
description: Leave balances of store colleagues from one legacy vendor differ after the dry-run migration.

title: Wrong back pay after barema update and indexation
description: Retroactive salary corrections after the barema update and indexation were calculated manually and were wrong.
resolution: Automated retro calculation in the payroll engine with the new baremas loaded by effective date; compliance review against the sector agreement.

title: Self-service for care staff without a smartphone
description: Care staff without a company smartphone cannot use the payslip app.
resolution: SMS-code login on shared ward computers and printed payslips on request.

title: Weekend and night premium missing on payslips
description: Overtime premium missing on payslips of night and weekend shifts in two nursing homes.
resolution: Premium rules per shift type added, correction run, automated check on premium hours per shift.

title: Works council approval for time registration
description: The works council must approve the new time registration for nursing staff before payroll use.
resolution: Consultation pack, privacy impact assessment and a pilot on two wards; works council approved.

title: Pay gap report per category of workers
description: HR needs an adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report per category of workers based on the job classification.
resolution: Delivered from one integrated system with the job classification as job architecture; gap calculated automatically per category of workers.

title: Two local payroll vendors for Germany and Austria
description: Two local payroll vendors with different calendars and wage types for the German and Austrian entities.
resolution: One payroll provider, one payroll calendar, harmonised wage types and one integrated reporting layer.

title: Works council approval for the time registration interface
description: The works council must approve the time registration interface to payroll.
resolution: Works agreement on purpose, retention and access rights, prepared with a communication pack.

title: Leave balances in days versus hours after migration
description: Leave balances differ after the migration because the vendors used different leave units.
resolution: All balances converted to one unit, reconciliation report per person and sign-off per plant.

title: Overtime supplement missing after go-live
description: Overtime premium missing on payslips after the migration: collective agreement supplements not calculated.
resolution: Collective agreement supplements mapped to wage types with an automated premium calculation from the attendance data; missing supplements paid in the next run.

title: Pay gap report for Germany and Austria
description: HR needs an adjusted and unadjusted pay gap report for the EU Pay Transparency Directive for both countries.
